sources.name: KERA News
sources.notes: Nonprofit NPR member station for North Texas and the most consistent broadcaster on Dallas and Fort Worth city council business; KERA also owns the Denton Record-Chronicle. In 2026 the station moved from keranews.org to kera.org: the old /news.rss feed and every keranews.org tag and section page now redirect to the generic kera.org/news page, which answers automated requests with 403. The site-wide feed at https://www.kera.org/feed/ was verified on 2026-10-10 (RSS 2.0, 10 current items). It mixes in national NPR and PBS stories, so requirePlace keeps only items that name a DFW place. The kera.org tag and category feeds and pages all return 403 to automated requests, so no KERA topic pages are linked.

sources.name: The Dallas Morning News
sources.notes: Largest DFW daily, now on Hearst's publishing platform. No RSS feed could be found: the old Arc outbound feed paths return 404 and the page metadata reports rssFeedUrl as null, so no feed URL is given. The site serves a bot challenge to the fetch tool, but curl confirms the section pages load; the Dallas City and County Local Government section lives at /news/dallas-local-government/.

sources.name: Fort Worth Report
sources.notes: Nonprofit newsroom with a dedicated local government desk covering Fort Worth City Council, Tarrant County and suburbs like Bedford. Every tag has its own feed at /tag/<slug>/feed/ (for example /tag/fort-worth-city-council/feed/). The site rate-limits bursts of requests with HTTP 429, so poll gently. Main feed verified with the fetch tool.

sources.name: Fort Worth Star-Telegram
sources.notes: McClatchy daily for Tarrant County. The feed URL that was configured (McClatchy's standard local-news widget feed) never answered: every fetch hit the 6 second timeout, which stalled news requests, and on 2026-10-10 the host still refused connections from this environment. It was removed rather than replaced, because no working feed URL could be verified. Check the site manually before adding a feed back.

sources.name: Dallas Observer
sources.notes: Alt-weekly with pointed City Hall and police coverage. The site returns 403 to the fetch tool, so the feed was verified with curl (RSS 2.0, 10 items); the legacy /dallas/Rss.xml path redirects to /feed/. News section at /news/.

sources.name: D Magazine
sources.notes: City magazine whose FrontBurner blog follows Dallas City Hall closely; tag pages at /tag/dallas-city-hall/, /tag/dallas-city-council/ and /tag/dart/. The site returns 403 to the fetch tool, so the feed was verified with curl (RSS 2.0, 12 items).

sources.name: Community Impact (Dallas-Fort Worth)
sources.notes: Free hyperlocal chain with a Government section in every edition that summarizes council and planning-and-zoning meetings. The network feed at /rss/ that was configured covers every Texas market, so most of its items were about Houston, Austin and San Antonio. The Dallas-Fort Worth government feed at /rss/dallas-fort-worth/government/ was verified on 2026-10-10 (RSS, 40 items covering about two and a half weeks of council, county and agency stories from all nine DFW editions). The Lewisville/Flower Mound/Highland Village and Coppell/Valley Ranch/Las Colinas editions no longer exist as separate editions, so use Star Local Media and Cross Timbers Gazette for those cities.

sources.name: Community Impact (DFW elections)
sources.notes: Election section of the nine DFW editions: candidate Q&As for city, county, school board and appraisal district races, bond and tax rate elections, and polling place changes. Feed verified on 2026-10-10 (RSS, 40 items covering about five weeks).

sources.name: Community Impact (DFW education)
sources.notes: Education section of the nine DFW editions, mostly ISD board decisions (tax rates, boundaries, superintendent searches, legislative priorities). Feed verified on 2026-10-10 (RSS, 40 items covering about a month).

sources.name: Community Impact (Plano)
sources.notes: Edition feed verified with the fetch tool. Government-only feed also verified at https://communityimpact.com/rss/plano/government/; section pages at /plano/government/, /plano/transportation/, /plano/development/, /plano/education/, /plano/business/. Switched on 2026-10-10 from the edition feed (/rss/plano/, mostly restaurant and business openings) to the edition's government feed, verified the same day (RSS, 40 items going back about three months).

sources.name: Community Impact (Richardson)
sources.notes: Edition feed verified with curl (RSS, 50 items). Government section at /richardson/government/ follows the same pattern as Plano. Switched on 2026-10-10 from the edition feed (/rss/richardson/, mostly restaurant and business openings) to the edition's government feed, verified the same day (RSS, 40 items going back about three months).

sources.name: Community Impact (Frisco)
sources.notes: Edition feed verified with curl (RSS, 50 items); government-only feed also confirmed at https://communityimpact.com/rss/frisco/government/. Switched on 2026-10-10 from the edition feed (/rss/frisco/, mostly restaurant and business openings) to the edition's government feed, verified the same day (RSS, 40 items going back about three months).

sources.name: Community Impact (McKinney)
sources.notes: Edition feed verified with curl (RSS, 50 items). Switched on 2026-10-10 from the edition feed (/rss/mckinney/, mostly restaurant and business openings) to the edition's government feed, verified the same day (RSS, 40 items going back about three months).

sources.name: Community Impact (Allen)
sources.notes: Edition feed verified with curl (RSS, 50 items). Switched on 2026-10-10 from the edition feed (/rss/allen/, mostly restaurant and business openings) to the edition's government feed, verified the same day (RSS, 40 items going back about three months).

sources.name: Community Impact (Grapevine, Colleyville, Southlake)
sources.notes: Edition feed verified with curl (RSS, 50 items). Switched on 2026-10-10 from the edition feed (/rss/grapevine-colleyville-southlake/, mostly restaurant and business openings) to the edition's government feed, verified the same day (RSS, 40 items going back about three months).

sources.name: Community Impact (Keller, Roanoke, Northeast Fort Worth)
sources.notes: Edition feed verified with curl (RSS, 50 items). This is the edition that covers Keller, Roanoke and the Northeast Tarrant suburbs including North Richland Hills. Switched on 2026-10-10 from the edition feed (/rss/keller-roanoke-northeast-fort-worth/, mostly restaurant and business openings) to the edition's government feed, verified the same day (RSS, 40 items going back about three months).

sources.name: Community Impact (Denton)
sources.notes: Not in the requested list but a live DFW edition; feed verified with curl (RSS, 50 items). Pairs well with the Denton Record-Chronicle. Switched on 2026-10-10 from the edition feed (/rss/denton/, mostly restaurant and business openings) to the edition's government feed, verified the same day (RSS, 40 items going back about three months).

sources.name: Community Impact (Prosper, Celina)
sources.notes: Not in the requested list but a live DFW edition for two fast-growing Collin County cities; feed verified with curl (RSS, 50 items). Switched on 2026-10-10 from the edition feed (/rss/prosper-celina/, mostly restaurant and business openings) to the edition's government feed, verified the same day (RSS, 40 items going back about three months).

sources.name: The Texas Tribune
sources.notes: Statewide nonprofit; best for state laws that constrain what city councils can do (property tax caps, preemption, school vouchers, data center rules). The /feeds/main/ path on the main domain 301-redirects to feeds.texastribune.org, which is the URL given. Topic pages at /topics/<slug>/ work for transportation, public-education, environment, health-care, energy, criminal-justice and politics; the housing and water topic slugs do not resolve to topic pages.

sources.name: Dallas Free Press
sources.notes: Nonprofit covering South and West Dallas, with a Dallas Documenters program that publishes notes from city council, park board and zoning meetings, and a student journalist program that is directly relevant to a teen audience. Site uses a single Dallas News archive at /dallas-news/ rather than topic categories.

sources.name: Dallas Weekly
sources.notes: Black-owned weekly founded in 1954; strong on southern Dallas housing, equity and elections. Feed verified with the fetch tool.

sources.name: Denton Record-Chronicle
sources.notes: Daily owned by KERA since 2023. Runs on the BLOX CMS, so the feed is a search endpoint; the fetch tool was rate-limited (429) but curl returned RSS with 25 items. News index at /news/. requirePlace is set because the search feed carries syndicated wire copy (NAPSI tips, statewide sports).

sources.name: Star Local Media
sources.notes: Chain of suburban weeklies (Plano Star Courier, Frisco Enterprise, McKinney Courier-Gazette, Allen American, Lewisville Leader, Coppell Gazette and others), which makes it the main council-coverage source for Lewisville, Flower Mound and Coppell now that Community Impact has dropped those editions. BLOX search-as-RSS feed verified with the fetch tool; it mixes in syndicated wire content. requirePlace is set because the search feed carries syndicated wire copy (Oklahoma sports, NAPSI tips) under the local mastheads.

sources.name: CandysDirt.com
sources.notes: Real estate news site that follows Dallas zoning cases, the City Plan Commission and the ForwardDallas land-use plan closely. The standard WordPress feed at /feed/ was verified on 2026-10-10 (RSS 2.0, 10 current items); the homepage itself sits behind a Cloudflare challenge for automated requests. Most items are home listings, which the relevance check drops; zoning and council stories come through.

sources.name: Fort Worth Weekly
sources.notes: Alt-weekly with opinionated Metropolis column on Fort Worth politics; the feed also carries sponsored lifestyle posts, so filter by category. Verified with the fetch tool.

sources.name: People Newspapers (Park Cities People, Preston Hollow People)
sources.notes: Community papers for the Park Cities and Preston Hollow; covers Highland Park and University Park town councils and Highland Park ISD. Verified with the fetch tool.

sources.name: NBC 5 Dallas-Fort Worth (KXAS)
sources.notes: Local feed verified with the fetch tool. Tag pages exist for some civic topics (/tag/dart/, /tag/housing/), but unknown tag slugs silently redirect to the homepage instead of returning 404, so test any new tag before linking it.

sources.name: WFAA (ABC 8)
sources.notes: TEGNA station; local syndication feed verified with the fetch tool. Section URLs are limited (politics and education paths returned 404) but /traffic works.

sources.name: FOX 4 News (KDFW)
sources.notes: Local news feed verified with the fetch tool. Topic pages live at /tag/<slug> (politics, education, crime-publicsafety, health, technology, pets-animals).

sources.name: CBS News Texas (KTVT)
sources.notes: Feed verified with the fetch tool but it mixes national CBS stories with local ones; /texas/local-news/ and /texas/tag/dart/ are the useful local pages. The feed carries national CBS stories, so requirePlace keeps only items that name a DFW place.

sources.name: Arlington Report
sources.notes: Fort Worth Report's Arlington newsroom (arlingtonreport.org redirects here). There is no dedicated section feed, so the Arlington tag feed is used; verified with the fetch tool. Government subsection at /arlington-government/.

sources.name: Advocate Magazine
sources.notes: Dallas neighborhood magazines covering council district-level issues. The root advocatemag.com/feed/ is stale, so the Lakewood/East Dallas edition feed is used (verified with the fetch tool); the Oak Cliff, Lake Highlands and Preston Hollow editions have their own feeds at oakcliff., lakehighlands. and prestonhollow.advocatemag.com/feed/ (each returned 10 items via curl). Some items are sponsored.

sources.name: Dallas Innovates
sources.notes: Owned by the Dallas Regional Chamber with editorial independence, so expect a business-friendly lens; good for data centers, startups and economic development deals. Verified with the fetch tool; sections at /business/, /education/, /impact/.

sources.name: Texas Metro News
sources.notes: Black community news outlet that republishes many City of Dallas announcements (park dedications, programs) alongside political coverage. Verified with the fetch tool.

sources.name: The Cross Timbers Gazette
sources.notes: Southern Denton County community paper; the best remaining local source for Flower Mound and Highland Village council news. Verified with the fetch tool.

sources.name: Local Profile
sources.notes: Collin County magazine mixing lifestyle with civic news. The fetch tool gets a 403, so the /rss/ feed was verified with curl (20 items).

sources.name: Dallas Voice
sources.notes: LGBTQ community outlet; covers council actions and elections affecting that community. Verified with the fetch tool.
